# Draft:Nadia Comeneci McQueen

African American wardrobe stylist, fashion producer, and business woman was born August 5th 1988 in Charlotte North Carolina. Branding her last name McQueenz was credited in the city of Charlotte for opening the doors to fashion by creating opportunities with her fashion productions and opening of the first fashion showroom in Charlotte North Carolina.She was the only fashion stylist in the state of North Carolina to own a showroom and to work for major companies like Nike and Fendi. A prolific fashion creator, McQueenz extended her influence beyond wardrobe styling and designing and began to be a pilar in her community by creating a nonprofit named the McQueenz Foundation. The foundation was fashion based but was used to raise money for parents and families needs throughout the year. Each year McQueenz put on a fashion show titled Welcome 2 CHARLIT Fashion show and expo to raise money for mental health expenses to families in need while offering production experience and training to upcoming fashion students, designers,models, and photographers.
